text:
lena-m: flagging a pattern: a handful of mid-market accounts are getting automated renewal nudges during our maintenance window. they’re annoyed. we need a quick fix in playbook scheduling to respect account timezone + safelist.
omar-s: agreed. root cause is cron-based runner that batches by UTC day. suggestion: add `account_local_window` check and a safelist override table.
lena-m: can we also add a telemetry attribute so CS can query which accounts were suppressed vs delayed? proposed tag: `renewal_workflow_action: sent|suppressed|delayed` and `suppress_reason: sched_window|safelist|duplicate`.
kevin-cs: also need a small admin UI endpoint for ops to add/remove safelisted accounts for manual outreach. simple PUT /admin/safelist/{account_id} should do. include audit log entry.
omar-s: implementing: add DB table `renewal_safelist(account_id, added_by, reason, added_at)` + index on account_id. will emit `safelist=true` in telemetry. sample SQL for backfill/remove:
```
-- add enterprise accounts to safelist
INSERT INTO renewal_safelist(account_id, added_by, reason, added_at)
SELECT account_id, 'kevin-cs', 'high-touch', now() FROM accounts WHERE tags @> array['enterprise'];

-- remove stale safelist entries older than 180 days
DELETE FROM renewal_safelist WHERE added_at < now() - interval '180 days';
```
lena-m: perfect. timeline? we need hotfix before EOD. also put a feature-flag `renewal.schedule_respect_local_window` default on for enterprise, off for others.
omar-s: can do hotfix with toggle. will add telemetry tags `renewal_action` and `suppress_reason`. ops-bot: deploy requested by omar-s: branch `renewal/safelist-window-hotfix` -> staging. CI queued.
kevin-cs: CS asks for a small daily report of suppressed accounts so they can follow up manually: include columns account_id, region, last_activity, suppress_reason. can you add a scheduled job?
omar-s: will add a daily job that emails CS leads and writes to S3. quick pseudo-query:
```
SELECT account_id, region, last_activity, suppress_reason FROM renewal_runs
WHERE run_date = current_date AND renewal_action = 'suppressed';
```
lena-m: add an alert if suppressed_count > 50 in any 24h window. we should catch mass suppression bugs.
kevin-cs: thumbs up. also document rollback: flip LD flag `renewal.schedule_respect_local_window` to off and remove job. owner: lena-m.
ops-bot: staging deploy success for branch `renewal/safelist-window-hotfix` at 2024-07-02T15:02:10Z. CI run id: 222111.
lena-m: testing on staging now with sample accounts spanning timezones. will post results in 30m.
